role: declarative transport adapter; no oracle predicates or productive operations
rules: This schema chooses serialization shapes only. The independent oracle must fix exact read requests, source-context selectors, projection fields and expected predicates before adapter assertion translation.
Passive hooks receive actual operation data. The adapter must not execute its own stabilization/retention loop or derive events from fixture predicates.
Missing required fields fail binding. Null is permitted only where explicitly declared optional; opaque or absent data cannot masquerade as a zero/empty value.

Identity tokens are backed by actual owner-local immutable reference/generation identity with a verified extraction. Fixture labels, hashes of expected results and synthetic event counters cannot provide object identity.
Event sequence numbers describe actual append order only. They are not producer/output identities.
The operation binding receives exact source, target/features and explicit projection requests; it must not receive expected predicates. Observation and assertion channels stay separate.

All lossless integer/IEEE encodings below preserve data; no repr/Debug projection may implement semantic comparison. Unknown runtime carriers retain their actual variant plus opaque identity and a binding gap, never implicit success.

types.U64: decimal digit string representing the complete unsigned 64-bit integer
types.I64: signed decimal string representing the complete signed 64-bit integer
types.U128: decimal digit string representing the complete unsigned 128-bit integer
types.Bits64: exactly sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits, IEEE bits without float normalization

Identity.token: string, stable only in this compilation's actual identity domain
Identity.domain: owner-qualified string identifying actual generation/allocation/resource domain

origin.extraction_kind: actual immutable reference | actual generation identity | audited reference-equality witness

Diagnostic.ordered_trace_with_spans: array<{variant: Call|Show|Import|Include, payload: string|null, span: Span}>

types.Result<T>: {result: Ok, value: T} | {result: Err, diagnostics: nonempty array<Diagnostic>}

ObservedValue.variant: exact runtime Value variant name from pinned closed inventory
ObservedValue.identity: Identity or null; required for identity-bearing unexpanded carrier
ObservedValue.binding_gap: null or exact reason projection is unavailable; never pass-compatible

types.RequestIdentityList: array<Identity> in actual request recording order

ResourceTuple.features: array<string> of enabled actual feature variants in declaration order

SnapshotProjection.counter_requests: array<{request_identity: Identity, typed_arguments: ObservedValue, result: Result<ObservedValue>}>
SnapshotProjection.counter_events: array<{key: ObservedValue, action: ObservedValue, location: U128, span: Span, generation_identity: Identity}> in actual event order
SnapshotProjection.parent_child_edges: array<{parent_generation_identity: Identity|null, child_generation_identity: Identity, producer_identity: Identity, context_location: U128, source_span: Span}>
SnapshotProjection.pages_positions: {page_store_identity: Identity, positions_identity: Identity, total_pages: U64, positions: array<{location: U128, page: U64, x_bits: Bits64, y_bits: Bits64}>}

observed_value_payloads.Content: {content_identity: Identity, exact_variant: string}; nested fields only if explicitly requested by independent oracle
observed_value_payloads.other_runtime_variants: Exact variant and actual opaque Identity plus explicit binding_gap until the oracle supplies the needed lossless payload projection; not implicit positive coverage

event_envelope.payload: the corresponding event_payloads object, all fields required

GenerationInvalidated.actual_reason: runtime invalidation discriminant plus actual affected identities

pending_independent_choices: Exact source Span/parent-path selectors for contexts and counter request keys/operations in every projection.
Typed payload shapes for Counter action/key and any other nonprimitive requested carrier; no omitted field receives credit.
Exact executable predicates over event arrays and global conditions, including every formerly prose-only assertion.

Mapping of actual execution identity in BodyStarted/BodyCompleted to ContributionRetained.original_execution_identity; original fixture has no corresponding field, so an independent schema addition or owner-local witness is required before asserting it.
